_: The laws and terms that the legal pages cite, by the names the pages use. tools/citations.js finds every numbered citation in the files below and gives it a law by these names; verification/check.js fails on a citation with no law, and on one whose article is not in a text that was fetched (verification/statutes-texts.json, kept by the weekly watch, or verification/sources-raw.json, fetched by tools/sources.js). `place` settles a name that laws of several places share. A law with `named` is referred to only by name, never by an article or section (the allow-list): a check fails if one is ever cited with a number, or is no longer named anywhere. `untraced` lists the citations whose source could not be fetched, each with what was tried; nothing may be added to it, and a citation leaves it when its source is fetched.
